cli.flag.lang: output language: tr | en (default: SENTRIX_LANGUAGE, then tr)
cli.sentrix.usage:
Usage: sentrix [--lang tr|en] <command> [flags]

  login --server URL --token TOKEN        save server URL and API token
  hosts                                   list hosts
  cve list [--severity S] [--kev] [--fixable] [--q TEXT]
                                          fleet vulnerabilities (S = minimum: low|medium|high|critical)
  patch list                              list patch plans
  patch plan (--hosts a,b | --group G) [--scope security|packages|all] [--packages p1,p2]
             [--reboot never|if_required|always] [--canary N] [--parallel N] [--no-wait]
                                          create a plan and show its dry run
  patch apply PLAN_ID --approve [--no-wait]
                                          approve a plan and follow it until finished
  patch status PLAN_ID                    show a plan
  patch cancel PLAN_ID                    cancel a plan
  version

Environment: SENTRIX_URL and SENTRIX_TOKEN override the saved login; SENTRIX_LANGUAGE (tr|en) sets the language.

cli.server.usage:
Usage: sentrix-server [--config FILE] [--lang tr|en] <command>

Commands:
  serve                       run the server (default)
  token create [--note N] [--group G] [--ttl 24h]
                              create a one-time agent enrolment token
  ca-fingerprint              print the CA fingerprint agents must pin
  stats                       print a JSON summary of stored data
  user create|reset-password --username U [--role R]
                              manage local users (password via SENTRIX_PASSWORD or stdin)
  audit [--target ID]         print the audit log
  channel create ...          add a notification channel (headless setup)
  rule create ...             add a threshold alert rule (headless setup)
  api-token create --user U [--scope read|operate|admin] [--name N]
                              create an API token for the sentrix CLI
  hosts                       list hosts and their status
  findings [--host NAME]      list vulnerability findings (TSV)
  sync-feeds                  download vulnerability feeds now and re-match hosts
  healthcheck                 exit 0 if the local UI listener answers /healthz
  version                     print version

Language: --lang, then SENTRIX_LANGUAGE, then the config file's "language", then tr.
cli.server.usageUser: usage: user create|reset-password --username U [--role admin|operator|viewer]  (password from SENTRIX_PASSWORD or stdin)
cli.server.usageChannel: usage: channel create --name N --kind webhook|slack|discord|ntfy --url URL [--topic T]
cli.server.usageRule: usage: rule create --name N --metric M [--labels L] --op '>' --value V [--for 5m] [--cooldown 6h] [--channel NAME]
cli.server.usageAPIToken: usage: api-token create --user NAME [--scope read|operate|admin] [--name NAME] [--ttl 720h]
cli.server.flag.group: group assigned to the enrolled host

ca fingerprint: %s

install + enrol (run as root on the host):
  curl -fsSL %s/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- --token %s --ca-fingerprint %s --lang %s

already installed:
  sentrix-agent enroll --server %s --token %s --ca-fingerprint %s
cli.agent.usage:
Usage: sentrix-agent [--config FILE] [--lang tr|en] <command>

Commands:
  run                         run the agent (default)
  enroll --server URL --token TOKEN --ca-fingerprint SHA256
                              enrol this host (one-time)
  inventory [--refresh]       print this host's inventory as JSON (no server needed)
  version                     print version
cli.agent.flag.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server CA
cli.agent.alreadyEnrolled: already enrolled (state in %s); use --force to re-enrol
cli.agent.flag.refresh: refresh package metadata (apt-get update / apk update) first
